title: Connector link heartbeat
description: The link's heartbeat (C-05.17): 15 s each way, any frame resets the peer's dead timer, 45 s of silence is a dead link. Unrelated to the daemon's own socket keep-alive (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/ws.js HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS 30 s), which keeps running on each relayed socket.

heartbeat.description: The connector's beat every heartbeat_ms (C-05.17), carrying contract 07's liveness body. Direction: connector to hub.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

ping.description: The hub's beat every heartbeat_ms (C-05.17). The connector echoes this frame's `at` as the next heartbeat body's echo_at. Direction: hub to connector.
